# Level 4 (Seurat object): Get sample-level metadata by aggregating cell-level metadata
```{r sussman 2024 metadata level 4}
sussman.2024.level4 <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'Final_Cohort_All_snRNA-seq.RDS'))
sussman.2024.level4$cell.barcode <- colnames(sussman.2024.level4)
sussman.2024.level4.metadata <- sussman.2024.level4@meta.data
dim(sussman.2024.level4.metadata)
write.table(sussman.2024.level4.metadata, paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'Final_Cohort_All_snRNA-seq_metadata.tsv'), sep = "\t", row.names=T, quote=F)

sussman.2024.level4.sample.metadata <- sussman.2024.level4.metadata %>% group_by(sampleID, region, orig.ident, timepoint, molecularClass, patient_id) %>% summarize(num.cells.in.seurat.obj = n())
write.table(sussman.2024.level4.sample.metadata, paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'Final_Cohort_All_snRNA-seq_sample_metadata.tsv'), sep = "\t", row.names=F, quote=F)
```



# Create merged Seurat object from level 3 count matrices from HTAN
```{r create seurat obj from count matrix}
sussman.2024.sample.metadata <- read.csv(paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'Final_Cohort_All_snRNA-seq_sample_metadata.tsv'), sep="\t")
                                          
count.data.dir <- paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'Level3Data/')
sample.ids <- list.dirs(count.data.dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)
length(sample.ids)

setdiff(sussman.2024.sample.metadata$orig.ident, sample.ids) # none
setdiff(sample.ids, sussman.2024.sample.metadata$orig.ident) # extra samples from level 3 raw counts (maybe not included in published level 4 seurat object because low quality?)
# output of above code: [1] "HTAN_pHGG_161_New_Reg1_snRNA"     "HTAN_pHGG_161_New_Reg1_snRNA_bak" "HTAN_pHGG_2594_Reg1_snRNA"        "HTAN_pHGG_2594_Reg2_snRNA"        "HTAN_pHGG_339_Reg1_snRNA"         "HTAN_pHGG_339_Reg2_snRNA"        
# [7] "HTAN_pHGG_7545_Reg2_snRNA"   

# For samples not in the level 4 metadata, use other samples with the same ID (different replicate) to get metadata
# 339 not associated with a timepoint/patient (it's not in Seurat object) so it could be any timepoint
# Checking the HTAN metadata, it looks like one region is associated with C547104 and another one is associated with C1060383
# So leaving patient info blank but both are initial so adding it as initial timepoint

seurat.obj.list <- list()
for (sample.id in sample.ids) {
  print(sample.id)
  
  counts <- Read10X(paste0(count.data.dir, sample.id))
  seurat.obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)
  seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.obj, pattern = "^MT-")  
  print(dim(seurat.obj))
  
  sample.metadata <- sussman.2024.sample.metadata %>% filter(orig.ident == sample.id)
  if (nrow(sample.metadata) == 0) { # sample not in level 4 seurat object
    
    extracted.sampleIDs <- unlist(str_extract_all(sample.id, "\\d{3,4}"))
    sampleID <- extracted.sampleIDs[length(extracted.sampleIDs)] # takes into account some sample.ids have 7316
    sID <- paste0('7316-', sampleID)
    
    seurat.obj$sampleID <- sID # e.g. 7316-1057
    
    if (str_detect(sample.id, 'Reg')) {
      region <- str_extract(sample.id, "Reg[12]")
    } else {
      region <- str_extract(sample.id, "R[12]")
    }
    
    seurat.obj$region <- region
    seurat.obj$orig.ident <- sample.id
    
    temp <- sussman.2024.sample.metadata %>% filter(sampleID == sID)
    
    if (sampleID == '339') {
      seurat.obj$molecularClass <- "Unknown" #"HGG - NOS"
      seurat.obj$patient_id <-"Unknown"  #"C70848"
      seurat.obj$timepoint <- "Initial CNS Tumor"
    } else {
      stopifnot(nrow(temp) > 0)
      seurat.obj$molecularClass <- unique(temp$molecularClass)
      seurat.obj$patient_id <- unique(temp$patient_id)
      seurat.obj$timepoint <- unique(temp$timepoint)
    }
    
    seurat.obj$num.cells.in.seurat.obj <- NA
  } else {
    seurat.obj$sampleID <- sample.metadata$sampleID
    seurat.obj$region <- sample.metadata$region
    seurat.obj$orig.ident <- sample.metadata$orig.ident
    seurat.obj$timepoint <- sample.metadata$timepoint
    seurat.obj$molecularClass <- sample.metadata$molecularClass
    seurat.obj$num.cells.in.seurat.obj <- sample.metadata$num.cells.in.seurat.obj
    seurat.obj$patient_id <- sample.metadata$patient_id
  }
  Idents(seurat.obj) <- 'orig.ident'
  
  seurat.obj.list[[sample.id]] <- seurat.obj
}

sussman.2024.raw <- merge(seurat.obj.list[[1]], seurat.obj.list[2:length(seurat.obj.list)], add.cell.ids = names(seurat.obj.list))
sussman.2024.raw[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sussman.2024.raw[["RNA"]])
sussman.2024.raw$sample.id <- sussman.2024.raw$orig.ident

sussman.2024.raw$Timepoint <- sapply(sussman.2024.raw$timepoint, function(x) case_when(
  x %in% c("Initial CNS Tumor", "Recurrence", "Progressive (Non-Autopsy)") ~ "Surgical",
  x == "Progressive (Autopsy)" ~ "Postmortem"
))

sussman.2024.raw$cell.id <- colnames(sussman.2024.raw)

all.samples.metadata.df <- sussman.2024.raw@meta.data
write.table(all.samples.metadata.df, paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'level3_all_cells_metadata.tsv'), row.names = F, quote = T, sep = '\t')
saveRDS(sussman.2024.raw, paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.seurat.obj.RDS'))
print('done')
```

# Merge all samples and remove doublets
```{r}
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.seurat.obj.RDS'))
print("Initial raw number of cells:")

sussman.2024.level4.metadata <- read.csv(paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'Final_Cohort_All_snRNA-seq_metadata.tsv'), sep = "\t")
sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select <- sussman.2024.level4.metadata %>% dplyr::select(TumorNormal, merged_cellType, orig.ident, cell.barcode)
sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select$cell.id <- paste0(sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select$orig.ident, "_", sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select$cell.barcode)
sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select$cell.id <-
  str_replace(
    sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select$cell.id,
    "_\\d+$",
    ""
  )
rownames(sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select) <- sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select$cell.id

setdiff(rownames(sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select), colnames(seurat.obj)) # should be zero

seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, sussman.2024.level4.metadata.select) # add metadata from original Seurat object

sample.not.used <- c("HTAN_pHGG_161_New_Reg1_snRNA", "HTAN_pHGG_161_New_Reg1_snRNA_bak", "HTAN_pHGG_2594_Reg1_snRNA", "HTAN_pHGG_2594_Reg2_snRNA", "HTAN_pHGG_339_Reg1_snRNA", "HTAN_pHGG_339_Reg2_snRNA", "HTAN_pHGG_7545_Reg2_snRNA")

seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = sample.id %ni% sample.not.used)

print("After removing samples not used:")
print(dim(seurat.obj))

# remove very low quality
seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (nCount_RNA >= 500) & (percent.mt <= 20))

print("After removing very low quality:")
print(dim(seurat.obj))
seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)

n.dims.use <- 20
seurat.obj.list <- list()
for (sample.id.i in sort(unique(seurat.obj$sample.id))) {
  print(sample.id.i)
  sample.dir <- paste0(results.dir, "Sussman2024/", "qc/", sample.id.i, "/")
  dir.create(sample.dir)
  seurat.obj.sample <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = sample.id == sample.id.i)
  print(dim(seurat.obj.sample))
  seurat.obj.sample <- find.doublets(seurat.obj.sample, pcs.use.doublet.finder=1:n.dims.use, qc.output.dir = sample.dir)
  seurat.obj.list[[sample.id.i]] <- seurat.obj.sample
}
seurat.obj <- merge(seurat.obj.list[[1]], seurat.obj.list[2:length(seurat.obj.list)])
Sys.setenv('R_MAX_VSIZE' = 400000000000)
rm(seurat.obj.list)
seurat.obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat.obj[["RNA"]])

saveRDS(seurat.obj, paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.very.low.quality.and.doublets.labeled.seurat.obj.RDS'))
```



# Annotate cluster-level cell types
```{r}

seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.very.low.quality.and.doublets.labeled.seurat.obj.RDS'))

seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = doubFind_res == "Singlet")
print("After removing doublets:")
print(dim(seurat.obj))

seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)
seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures)
seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, brain_signatures)

seurat.obj$timepoint.original <- seurat.obj$timepoint
seurat.obj$timepoint <- sapply(seurat.obj$timepoint.original, function(x) ifelse(x %in% c("Recurrence", "Progressive (Non-Autopsy)"), "Recurrence/Progressive (Non-Autopsy)", x))

seurat.obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj)
seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj)

seurat.obj <- RunPCA(seurat.obj, approx=F, seed.use = 42)
ElbowPlot(seurat.obj, ndims=50)

batch.correction <- F
n.dims.use <- 30

if (batch.correction) {
  seurat.obj <- RunHarmony(seurat.obj, "patient_id")
  reduction.use <- "harmony"
} else {
  reduction.use <- "pca"
}

seurat.obj <- FindNeighbors(seurat.obj, dims = 1:n.dims.use, nn.method = "rann", reduction = reduction.use)
seurat.obj <- FindClusters(seurat.obj, resolution = 2, algorithm = 1, random.seed = 0, n.start = 10)
seurat.obj <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj, dims = 1:n.dims.use, reduction = reduction.use)
seurat.obj$seurat_clusters <- as.character(seurat.obj$seurat_clusters)
seurat.obj$seurat_clusters <- factor(seurat.obj$seurat_clusters, levels = as.character(sort(unique(as.numeric(seurat.obj$seurat_clusters)))))


# annotate based on clusters and gene expression
cluster.information <- read_excel(paste0(results.dir, 'Sussman2024/', 'cluster_information.xlsx'), sheet=1)

df <- cluster.information %>% filter(clean == 'before', patient == "all") 
cluster.to.annotation.df <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(patient, clean)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "annotation",
    values_to = "cluster"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
  separate_rows(cluster, sep = ",\\s*") %>%  # split clusters
  mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster))


seurat.obj$annotation.l2 <- sapply(seurat.obj$seurat_clusters, function(x) ifelse(x %in% cluster.to.annotation.df$cluster, cluster.to.annotation.df %>% filter(cluster == x) %>% pull(annotation), "Malignant cluster"))
unique(seurat.obj$annotation.l2)
seurat.obj$annotation.l1 <- sapply(seurat.obj$annotation.l2, function(x) case_when(
  x %in% c("Oligodendrocytes", "OPC", "Astrocytes") ~ "Glial",
  x %in% c("Lymphoid", "Myeloid", "Other immune") ~ "Immune",
  x == "Malignant cluster" ~ "Malignant cluster",
  x %in% c("Excitatory neurons", "Inhibitory neurons") ~ "Neurons",
  x %in% c("Mural", "Endothelial") ~ "Vascular",
))

seurat.obj$low.quality.by.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) < nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff))
seurat.obj$annotation.l2.w.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row['low.quality.by.qc'] == TRUE, "Low quality", row['annotation.l2']))
seurat.obj$annotation.l1.w.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row['low.quality.by.qc'] == TRUE, "Low quality", row['annotation.l1']))


# UMAP
p.sample.id <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'sample.id', shuffle=TRUE, label=F, raster=T) + NoAxes() + NoLegend()
p.patient_id <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'patient_id', shuffle=TRUE, label=F, raster=T) + NoAxes() + patients.color.scale
p.timepoint <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'timepoint', shuffle=TRUE, raster=T) + NoAxes() + timepoints.color.scale
p.tumornormal <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='TumorNormal', shuffle=TRUE, raster=T) + NoAxes()
p.clusters <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='seurat_clusters', shuffle=TRUE, label=T, raster=T, label.size=2) + NoAxes()
p.merged.celltype <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='merged_cellType', shuffle=TRUE, raster=T) + NoAxes() + cell.type.color.scale
p.annotation.l1 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='annotation.l1', shuffle=TRUE, label=F, label.size=2, raster=T) + NoAxes() + cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale
p.annotation.l1.w.qc <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='annotation.l1.w.qc', shuffle=TRUE, label=F, label.size=2, raster=T) + NoAxes() + cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale
p.annotation.l2 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='annotation.l2', shuffle=TRUE, label=F, label.size=2, raster=T) + NoAxes() + cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.color.scale
p.annotation.l2.w.qc <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='annotation.l2.w.qc', shuffle=TRUE, label=F, label.size=2, raster=T) + NoAxes() + cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.color.scale

p.percent.mt <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'percent.mt', order=T, raster=T) + NoAxes()
p.ncount.rna <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'nCount_RNA', order=T, raster=T) + NoAxes()
p.nfeature.rna <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'nFeature_RNA', order=T, raster=T) + NoAxes()
p.postmortem.signature <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c('postmortem.signature'), order=T, raster=T) + NoAxes()
```
